results.title: Fix helm values so the chart templates

steps_log.output:
---
# Source: mychart/templates/deploy.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: release-name }
spec:
  replicas: 0
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "nginx:"

STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

replicaCount: "two"
image:
  repository: nginx

STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: {{ .Release.Name }} }
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount | int }}
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"

STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

steps_log.command:
cat > /tmp/nd/helm/mychart/values.yaml << 'EOF'
replicaCount: 2
image:
  repository: nginx
  tag: latest
EOF
steps_log.output: STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

---
# Source: mychart/templates/deploy.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: release-name }
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: "nginx:latest"

STDERR: Warning: Permanently added '192.168.2.175' (ED25519) to the list of known hosts.

steps_log.content:
Fixed `values.yaml` with two changes:

1. **`replicaCount: "two"` → `replicaCount: 2`** — The template uses `| int` to convert the value, but `"two"` can't be parsed as an integer. Changed to a proper numeric value.

2. **Added `tag: latest`** — The template references `.Values.image.tag` but it was missing from values.yaml, resulting in an empty image tag (`nginx:`).

The chart now renders successfully.
